paraphrases.title: Binary float adds 0.1 + 0.2 as 0.30000000000000004
paraphrases.body: cartTotal accumulates floats, so items of 0.1 and 0.2 total 0.30000000000000004 instead of 0.3. Sum integer cents. Proof: 0.1 + 0.2 gives 0.30000000000000004 on this head.

paraphrases.title: Rounding error: 0.1 items sum to 0.30000000000000004
paraphrases.body: Adding 0.1 and 0.2 in binary floating point yields 0.30000000000000004, not exact cents. Proof: 0.1 plus 0.2 is 0.30000000000000004 here.
